For leakage measurement, use the supplied 2-inch (5 cm) spacer; operate at maximum output; hold the probe perpendicular to the surface; move it along the shaded area at less than 2.5 cm/sec (1 in/sec).

Service personnel should report certified oven units with emission above 5 mW/cm² to the manufacturer, importer, or assembler; repair them at no cost to the owner; ascertain the cause; and instruct the owner not to use the unit until compliant.

conditions.text: Leakage with the outer panels removed must be less than 5 mW/cm².
When replacing the magnetron, measure before installing the outer case and after all necessary components are replaced or adjusted.
Avoid contacting any high voltage parts.
Do not exceed meter full scale deflection.
Hold the test probe by the grip portion of the handle; keep the operator’s hand away from the space between the handle and probe to avoid a false reading.
Move the test probe no faster than 1 inch/sec (2.5 cm/sec) along the shaded area to avoid a false reading.
When testing near a door corner, keep the probe perpendicular to the surface and move it horizontally along the oven surface to avoid possible probe damage.
